pairs.target: gé le yírì ,
pairs.english: A day passed,

pairs.target: dào le tóng nài lěi chī miàn de rìzi .
pairs.english: and it was the day for noodles with Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 到了同奈蕾吃面的日子。

pairs.target: tā yuē de shì zhèngwǔ ,
pairs.english: She had arranged to meet at noon,

pairs.target: tǎ wéi què zài miàn pū kāimén shí jiù dào le .
pairs.english: but Tavi was already there when the noodle shop opened.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维却在面铺开门时就到了。

pairs.target: tā méi jìnqù ,
pairs.english: He did not go in,

pairs.target: xiān yánjiē zǒu dào xuégōng xiàpō chù de xié tān .
pairs.english: first walking along the street to the shoe stall down the slope from the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 先沿街走到学宫下坡处的鞋摊。

pairs.target: tānzhǔ zhèng gěi yìzhī xuēzǐ dīng zhǎng ,
pairs.english: The stallholder was nailing a new heel onto one boot,
pairs.hanzi: 摊主正给一只靴子钉掌，

pairs.target: jiào tā bié zhàn zài luò dīng de nàbiān .
pairs.english: and told him not to stand where the nails might fall.
pairs.hanzi: 叫他别站在落钉的那边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng pángbiān ràng le ràng ,
pairs.english: Tavi moved off to one side, out of the way,

pairs.target: kàn le bàntiān ,
pairs.english: and watched for quite a while,

pairs.target: cái fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí zài mō bāo lǐ de zhǐ .
pairs.english: before noticing he'd been feeling the paper in his bag all along.
pairs.hanzi: 才发现自己一直在摸包里的纸。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ wǎng bāo dǐ tuī le tuī ,
pairs.english: He pushed the paper farther down to the bottom of his bag

pairs.target: qù miàn pù ménqián kàn jià pái .
pairs.english: and went to look at the price board outside the noodle shop.

pairs.target: zuì piányi de qīng tāngmiàn yě bǐ tā jìde de guì le yìméi qián .
pairs.english: Even the cheapest noodles in clear broth now cost one coin more than he remembered.
pairs.hanzi: 最便宜的清汤面也比他记得的贵了一枚钱。

pairs.target: tā shù guò kǒudài ,
pairs.english: He counted what was in his pocket:

pairs.target: gòuchī ,
pairs.english: enough to eat,

pairs.target: tiān ròu biàn búgòu le .
pairs.english: but not enough to add meat.

pairs.target: nài lěi láide qiàhǎo ,
pairs.english: Nerai arrived right on time,

pairs.target: xiùkǒu zhān zhemò ,
pairs.english: with ink staining her cuff,

pairs.target: shēnshǒu biàn bǎ zhuōshàng nà zhī kōng wǎn bō yuǎn le xiē .
pairs.english: and reached out to push the empty bowl a little farther away across the table.
pairs.hanzi: 伸手便把桌上那只空碗拨远了些。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā xián bù gānjìng ,
pairs.english: Tavi assumed she thought it unclean,

pairs.target: tā què bǎ xiùzǐ fān gěi tā kàn ,
pairs.english: but she turned her sleeve over to show him.

pairs.target: shuō gāng cóng chéngzhōng yíwèi wěituōrén nàér lái ,
pairs.english: She said she had just come from a client in the city.
pairs.hanzi: 说刚从城中一位委托人那儿来，

pairs.target: mò hái méi gān ,
pairs.english: The ink was not dry yet,

pairs.target: bié ràng diànjiā duō xǐ yìzhī wǎn .
pairs.english: and there was no need to give the shopkeeper one extra bowl to wash.

pairs.target: liǎng rén gè yào le miàn .
pairs.english: Both of them asked for noodles.

pairs.target: tā méi wèn gōngkè ,
pairs.english: She didn't ask about schoolwork.

pairs.target: xiān jiāng zìjǐ de qián shù dào zhuōshàng ,
pairs.english: First she counted out her own money onto the table,
pairs.hanzi: 先将自己的钱数到桌上，

pairs.target: yòu yòng shǒu gàizhù yìméi .
pairs.english: then covered one coin with her hand.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le tā yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi gave her a glance.

pairs.target: tā shuō zhè yìméi dé liú zhe huíqù bǔxié ,
pairs.english: She said this one coin had to stay put until she went back to have her shoes mended.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这一枚得留着回去补鞋，

pairs.target: bùnéng yīnwèi liǎnggè rén zuòzài yìzhāng zhuōshàng ,
pairs.english: It wouldn't do just because two people sat at a single table
pairs.hanzi: 不能因为两个人坐在一张桌上，

pairs.target: jiù bǎ dōulǐ de qián quán suàn jìn fàn lǐ . "
pairs.english: to count all the money in their pockets toward dinner.
pairs.hanzi:
就把兜里的钱全算进饭里。

“

pairs.target: tāmen yào nǐ zài zǒu yítàng ? "
pairs.english: “Do they want you to make another trip?”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn . "
pairs.english: Tavi asked.

pairs.target: tāmen yào wǒ shǎo xiě jǐgè zì . "
pairs.english: “They want me to leave out a few words.”

pairs.target: nài lěi yòng zhǐjiān zhàn le chá ,
pairs.english: Nerai dipped a fingertip into the tea,

pairs.target: zài zhuōshàng xiě le yígè " zàn ".
pairs.english: and wrote a single character on the table: “Temporary.”

pairs.target: nà rén mǎi de shì yífèn dī shuǐ shí zǒu dào chéngxià hétān de lù tú ,
pairs.english: What the man had bought was a map for walking down to the river flats below the city at low water.
pairs.hanzi: 那人买的是一份低水时走到城下河滩的路图，

pairs.target: nádào shǒu què xiǎng tiē zài diànlǐ chángyòng ,
pairs.english: Once he got it, though, he wanted to post it in the shop for regular use.
pairs.hanzi: 拿到手却想贴在店里常用，

pairs.target: xián zhè zì jiào kèrén yóuyù .
pairs.english: He complained that the character made customers hesitate.

pairs.target: tā yǐ shuō guò bùnéng shān ,
pairs.english: She had already said it could not be deleted.

pairs.target: jīntiān qù , shì yào tīngtīng
pairs.english: She went today to find out

pairs.target: duìfāng yuànbuyuàn lìngfù yìzhāng zhī huà dào yìng àn de tú .
pairs.english: whether the client would pay separately for a map showing only the way to firm ground.
pairs.hanzi: 对方愿不愿另付一张只画到硬岸的图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng tā shuō yuànbuyuàn .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for her to say whether the client would.

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ chá zì mǒ kāi ,
pairs.english: Nerai rubbed away the character she'd traced in tea

pairs.target: shuō bù zhīdào , rénjiā zhī jiào tā liú gè jià .
pairs.english: and said she didn't know: he'd only told her to leave a price.
pairs.hanzi: 说不知道，人家只叫她留个价。

pairs.target: miànshàng lái le ,
pairs.english: The noodles arrived,

pairs.target: liǎngwǎn lǐ gè fú zhe jǐpiàn cōng .
pairs.english: with a few slices of scallion floating in each of the two bowls.

pairs.target: tā xiān chī le yìkǒu ,
pairs.english: She took a bite first,

pairs.target: xián tàng ,
pairs.english: found it too hot,

pairs.target: bǎ kuàizi jià zài wǎnkǒu děng le piànkè .
pairs.english: and rested her chopsticks across the rim of her bowl for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 把筷子架在碗口等了片刻。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái náchū zìjǐ de biǎo ,
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi take out his own form
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才拿出自己的表，

pairs.target: zhǐ gěi tā kàn zìjǐ liúkōng de nà gé .
pairs.english: and showed her where he had left the box blank.
pairs.hanzi: 指给她看自己留空的那格。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi tā huì shuō zhè gé liú dé hǎo .
pairs.english: He assumed she'd say it was good to leave that box blank.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为她会说这格留得好。

pairs.target: tā zhī wèn ,
pairs.english: She only asked,

pairs.target: jiāo biǎo nàtiān ruò háishì kōng de ,
pairs.english: if it was still empty the day he handed in the form,

pairs.target: tā néng bunéng rěnzhù bù tián yígè kànqǐlái héshì de míngzì .
pairs.english: could he resist filling it with a name that seemed suitable?
pairs.hanzi: 他能不能忍住不填一个看起来合适的名字。

pairs.target: tā méi lìkè dá .
pairs.english: He did not answer right away.

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén bǎ shī xié fàngzài tàiyáng lǐ ,
pairs.english: Outside the window someone had set wet shoes out in the sun,
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人把湿鞋放在太阳里，

pairs.target: xié jiān cháo jiē ,
pairs.english: their toes facing the street.

pairs.target: guòlù de rén měi huí dōu dé duō ràng bànbù .
pairs.english: Every single person passing had to step aside an extra half step each time.
pairs.hanzi: 过路的人每回都得多让半步。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ mǐlā shuō yào zìjǐ fú mùpiàn ,
pairs.english: He remembered Mira asking him to steady the wood,
pairs.hanzi: 他想起米拉说要自己扶木片，

pairs.target: méi shuō yào tā tì tā juédìng nǎ tóu huì dǎo .
pairs.english: not asking him to decide for her which end would fall.
pairs.hanzi: 没说要他替她决定哪头会倒。

pairs.target: yúshì tā shuō ,
pairs.english: So he said,

pairs.target: dé xiān qù wèn ,
pairs.english: he'd have to go ask first.

pairs.target: wèn búdào jiù liú zhe ;
pairs.english: If he couldn't get an answer, he'd leave it as it was.

pairs.target: kě tā háishì xiǎng zhīdào ,
pairs.english: But he still wanted to know

pairs.target: yǒuméiyǒu rén huì yīn nà yì gé méitián jiù búràng tā chūqù . "
pairs.english: whether anyone would actually stop him from going out because that one box hadn't been filled in.
pairs.hanzi:
有没有人会因那一格没填就不让他出去。

“

pairs.target: yǒu a . "
pairs.english: “Yes, there is.”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ nà méi bǔxié de qián tuīhuí xiùlǐ , "
pairs.english: Nerai slipped that shoe repair coin back into her sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把那枚补鞋的钱推回袖里，“

pairs.target: yǒushí jiùshì wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Sometimes it is me.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tái yǎnkàn tā .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up at her.

pairs.target: tā zhèng dītóu tiāo wǎn lǐ yìgēn tèbié cháng de miàn ,
pairs.english: She was looking down, trying to pick up a particularly long noodle from the bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 她正低头挑碗里一根特别长的面，

pairs.target: tiāo le liǎnghuí hái méi tiāo duàn .
pairs.english: She'd tried twice and still hadn't broken it.

pairs.target: tā biēzhe méi xiào ,
pairs.english: He held back a laugh,

pairs.target: shēn kuàizi tì tā yā le yìtóu .
pairs.english: and reached out with his chopsticks to pin one end for her.

pairs.target: tā kàn le tā yìyǎn ,
pairs.english: She gave him a look

pairs.target: shuō zhèhuí zěnme bù děng rén diǎntóu .
pairs.english: and asked why he hadn't waited for a nod this time.
pairs.hanzi: 说这回怎么不等人点头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn bǎ kuàizi sōng le ,
pairs.english: Tavi quickly let the chopsticks go loose.

pairs.target: tā biàn xiào chū shēng lái ,
pairs.english: She suddenly let out a peal of laughter,

pairs.target: jiào tā bié sōng ,
pairs.english: telling him not to let go,

pairs.target: miàn dōu yào liáng le .
pairs.english: the noodles were getting cold already.
